ayahs.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوࣰ ا
ayahs.en: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
ayahs.e2: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺
ayahs.tr: Waz-zaariyaati zarwaa

ayahs.ar: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
ayahs.e2: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain
ayahs.tr: Falhaamilaati wiqraa

ayahs.ar: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And those [ships] sailing with ease
ayahs.e2: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease
ayahs.tr: Faljaariyaati yusraa

ayahs.ar: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
ayahs.en: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter
ayahs.e2: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command
ayahs.tr: Falmuqassimaati amraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, what you are promised is true
ayahs.e2: Indeed, what you are promised is true
ayahs.tr: Innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And indeed, the recompense is to occur
ayahs.e2: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass
ayahs.tr: Wa innad deena la waaqi

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
ayahs.en: By the heaven containing pathways
ayahs.e2: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design
ayahs.tr: Wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلࣲ مُّخۡتَلِفࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, you are in differing speech
ayahs.e2: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺
ayahs.tr: Innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif

ayahs.ar: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
ayahs.en: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded
ayahs.e2: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it
ayahs.tr: Yu'faku 'anhu man ufik

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ
ayahs.en: Destroyed are the falsifiers
ayahs.e2: Condemned are the liars—
ayahs.tr: Qutilal kharraasoon

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةࣲ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.en: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless
ayahs.e2: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless
ayahs.tr: Allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon

ayahs.ar: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.en: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense
ayahs.e2: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
ayahs.tr: Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud Deen

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
ayahs.en: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
ayahs.e2: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
ayahs.tr: Yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon

ayahs.ar: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
ayahs.en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”
ayahs.tr: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs
ayahs.tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good
ayahs.e2: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺
ayahs.tr: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen

ayahs.ar: كَانُواْ قَلِيلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: They used to sleep but little of the night
ayahs.e2: they used to sleep only little in the night
ayahs.tr: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon

ayahs.ar: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness
ayahs.e2: and pray for forgiveness before dawn
ayahs.tr: Wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon

ayahs.ar: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقࣱّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
ayahs.en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived
ayahs.e2: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor
ayahs.tr: Wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom

ayahs.ar: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
ayahs.e2: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith
ayahs.tr: Wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen

ayahs.ar: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see
ayahs.e2: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see
ayahs.tr: Wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon

ayahs.ar: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised
ayahs.e2: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised
ayahs.tr: Wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking
ayahs.e2: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak
ayahs.tr: Fawa Rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
ayahs.en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham
ayahs.e2: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺
ayahs.tr: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡمࣱ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”
ayahs.tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلࣲ سَمِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
ayahs.e2: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf
ayahs.tr: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat
ayahs.e2: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”
ayahs.tr: Faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon

ayahs.ar: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةࣰۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy
ayahs.e2: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son
ayahs.tr: Fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem

ayahs.ar: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةࣲ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman
ayahs.e2: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”
ayahs.tr: Fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing
ayahs.e2: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem

ayahs.ar: ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers
ayahs.e2: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
ayahs.e2: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

ayahs.ar: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةࣰ مِّن طِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: To send down upon them stones of clay
ayahs.e2: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay
ayahs.tr: Linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen

ayahs.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors
ayahs.e2: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
ayahs.tr: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers
ayahs.e2: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city
ayahs.tr: Fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims
ayahs.e2: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
ayahs.en: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment
ayahs.e2: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment
ayahs.tr: Wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem

ayahs.ar: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority
ayahs.e2: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof
ayahs.tr: Wa fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.en: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman
ayahs.e2: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”
ayahs.tr: Fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy
ayahs.e2: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy
ayahs.tr: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem

ayahs.ar: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
ayahs.en: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind
ayahs.e2: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind
ayahs.tr: Wa fee 'Aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem

ayahs.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
ayahs.en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins
ayahs.e2: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes
ayahs.tr: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem

ayahs.ar: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time
ayahs.e2: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”
ayahs.tr: Wa fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen

ayahs.ar: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on
ayahs.e2: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on
ayahs.tr: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon

ayahs.ar: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامࣲ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
ayahs.en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves
ayahs.e2: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped
ayahs.tr: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen

ayahs.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient
ayahs.e2: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people
ayahs.tr: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدࣲ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander
ayahs.e2: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺
ayahs.tr: Wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer
ayahs.e2: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out
ayahs.tr: Wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon

ayahs.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.en: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember
ayahs.e2: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon

ayahs.ar: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner
ayahs.e2: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you
ayahs.tr: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner
ayahs.e2: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”
ayahs.tr: Wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
ayahs.en: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman
ayahs.e2: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”
ayahs.tr: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon

ayahs.ar: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people
ayahs.e2: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people
ayahs.tr: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومࣲ‏
ayahs.en: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed
ayahs.e2: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed
ayahs.tr: Fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom

ayahs.ar: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers
ayahs.e2: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers
ayahs.tr: Wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
ayahs.en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me
ayahs.e2: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me
ayahs.tr: Wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon

ayahs.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقࣲ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
ayahs.en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me
ayahs.e2: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me
ayahs.tr: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength
ayahs.e2: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty
ayahs.tr: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبࣰ ا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
ayahs.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me
ayahs.e2: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺
ayahs.tr: Fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon

ayahs.ar: فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised
ayahs.e2: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of
ayahs.tr: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon
